svg.title: Burgundy study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Burgundy; 2: Chablis; 3: Gevrey-Chambertin; 4: Vosne-Romanée; 5: Meursault; 6: Chassagne-Montrachet; 7: Mercurey; 8: Mâcon; 9: Aine; 10: Broin; 11: Dijon; 12: Troyes

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
